With the House majority as narrow as it is, a handful of spoiler candidates in tight races could swing control on their own, which means the threat alone changes the math for everybody involved. Piers Morgan pushes on whether the falling out between Musk and the administration is really about spending policy or simply a collision between two enormous egos, and Jack gives an answer about government contracts, defense work, and space programs that says more about the relationship than any of the public statements have.
